1 • BIG PICTURE

What is “updated”?

18regions in the current PSGC
82provinces in the current PSGC
NIR returns: Republic Act No. 12000 established the Negros Island Region in 2024, bringing the country to 18 regions.
Sulu: the updated PSGC places Sulu in Region IX (Zamboanga Peninsula), rather than BARMM.
NCR: it is a region but has no provinces in the PSGC list.

PSA latest PSGC publication shown on its site: “Philippine Standard Geographic Code as of 30 June 2026.”
